summary: Changes how the overview estimates subscription spending for the selected date range (new calculatePaidCount based on the previous renewal date; the overview now loads all subscriptions, not just active ones), adds a cancelled_at date that is set when a subscription is switched off (new column, no migration), shows 'Cancel Date' and previous renewal date in the subscriptions table, and bumps a few packages.

statements.why: pages/app/index.js drops ?active=true, so inactive subscriptions now feed the spend totals. calculatePaidCount (utils/date.js) only zeroes a subscription when it has a valid cancelled_at, and every subscription switched off before this commit has none, so those count as paid again. The 'Subscriptions'/'Total spent'/balance figures on the overview are overstated.

statements.text: The app page now says "Estimated spent amount for selected date range."
The agent changed the subscriptions all and subscriptions update parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: True but uninformative: /all now returns every subscription (active filter and field whitelist removed) with prev_renewal_date and paid_count; /update now saves cancelled_at. Both still require login (withUserAuth) and are scoped to the user.

statements.text: Subscriptions now also store the cancelled date.
Update your database: run `npx prisma migrate dev` (live: `npx prisma migrate deploy`). The database's structure changed, but no migration was created.
statements.why: Right that the column must be added, but this project doesn't use Prisma Migrate (prisma/migrations holds .ts scripts; package.json has 'dbpush': prisma db push). `migrate deploy` won't add the column; `npm run dbpush` / `prisma db push` is what works here.
package.json bump; resend sends the usage/plan emails (lib/auth.js).

misses.what: The overview's estimated subscription spend (and total spent/balance) changes: the formula now counts payments from the previous renewal date, and subscriptions turned off before this change (no cancel date) are counted as paid again, inflating totals.

Switching a subscription off now records today's date as its cancel date (shown in a new 'Cancel Date' column); switching it back on clears it. The renewal date column now shows a date for inactive subscriptions too (used to show '-'), plus a 'prev:' date.
/api/subscriptions/all now returns all subscription columns (field whitelist removed), including internal ones like nameHash/user_id, but only for the logged-in user's own rows.
